stops.date_confidence: 1891 is the year Google Books' bibliographic record gives for the Humboldt Publishing Company's American edition of Fabian Essays in Socialism (Social Science Library Issue 6, ed. W.D.P. Bliss), the firm's own address at 19 Astor Place printed on its Humboldt Library of Science pamphlet series; no month given, day defaults to 01.
